turns.text: Please be careful. That's one of the most common rental scams.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Scammers often copy photos from real listings. A rent that seems too good for the area is another warning sign.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Never pay before you've seen the place in person, or had a trusted person view it. And never send money by bank transfer to someone you can't verify.

turns.text: What should I do with the listing?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Report it to the website. You might save someone else from losing their money.
